summary: Iteration 19 — WorkHop 8-part UX overhaul (backend + frontend). Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (test_iteration_19_ux_overhaul.py). /api/leads/preview returns exactly 50 enriched leads with area, rate_hr>0, intro, languages[], delivery_days, reviews_count. /api/pros/lead-1 exposes the same fields + reviews. POST /api/freelancer/submit accepts new profile fields + Fiverr import (external_platform=fiverr, external_rating=4.8, external_reviews=120) and persists; resulting /api/pros/{fid} returns rating=4.8, external_rating_source='fiverr', reviews_count=120. external_rating=7.0 correctly returns 400. Real verified freelancer is merged into /api/leads/preview (>=51 when a real pro exists). Frontend (375x667): (1) Landing shows 'I'M LOOKING FOR A JOB' with no 'I'M A PRO' anywhere; tap → /freelancer/jobs. (2) Jobs feed shows 11 jobs-cat-tile-* (row + ALL + 9 illustrated tiles); Graphics tile filters 202→46 jobs. (3) Search bar opens CategoryBrowser; Programming & Tech → 16 subcategories → tapping Website Development closes modal and filters feed. Typing 'logo' yields live suggestions (2 found). (4) jobs-filter-btn opens FilterSheet with budget/distance; filter-budget-0-1000 + apply shows badge count '1' and correctly filters feed; RESET clears badge and restores 202. (5) /employer: 11 lead-cat-tile-*; 50 lead cards baseline; lead-card-0 shows intro (Rohan Verma UI/UX 86 gigs Indiranagar), stats row (0.4km, ₹450/hr, 1d delivery, 86 jobs), lead-phone-0 blurred '+91 ••••• •••••', lead-portfolio-0 blurred '████████████.in'. leads-search-wrap opens the same CategoryBrowser. leads-filter-btn has budget/distance/language/delivery; KANNADA filter → 50→25 leads with badge '1'; RESET → 50 leads, badge cleared. (6) Tapping lead-card-0 opens /pro/lead-2 with 4 stat boxes (4.9/72 reviews, 121 jobs, 2d delivery, ₹600/hr), ABOUT, LANGUAGES, pro-contact-card with blurred phone+portfolio, pro-unlock-btn 'UNLOCK THIS LEAD · ₹199'. (7) Persistence contract validated: setting workhop_employer_unlocked=1 → pro-unlocked-badge appears, pro-unlock-btn removed, phone (+91 98212 44011) + portfolio (rohanv.design) revealed; /employer shows unlocked-badge and lead-phone-0 unblurred (verifies feature 4/5 persistence). (8) Wizard step 3 (hydrated paid+aadhaar-verified state via localStorage workhop_freelancer_id + workhop_session_token=test_token_workhop_e2e): all fields present — phone-input, skill-input, profile-cat-* chips, profile-location-btn, rate-input, delivery-chip-1/3/7/14, lang-chip-english/hindi/kannada/etc, intro-input, external-yes-btn (reveals ext-platform-fiverr, ext-platform-upwork, ext-url-input, ext-rating-input, ext-reviews-input) and external-no-btn (hides all four ext inputs). submit-btn is aria-disabled='true' pre-fill and gates on required fields. NOTE: The Razorpay ₹199 unlock modal itself was NOT interactively completed (out-of-scope per agent note about UPI dashboard block); the persistence contract downstream of successful payment was validated via direct AsyncStorage set. DB cleanup performed — 0 TEST_ freelancers remain, /api/leads/preview back to 50.
